query:
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN observacoes LIKE '%[Import]%' THEN CAST(valor AS DECIMAL(15,2)) ELSE 0 END) as total_import,
  SUM(CASE WHEN observacoes LIKE '%Fluxo%' THEN CAST(valor AS DECIMAL(15,2)) ELSE 0 END) as total_fluxo,
  SUM(CASE WHEN observacoes NOT LIKE '%[Import]%' AND observacoes NOT LIKE '%Fluxo%' THEN CAST(valor AS DECIMAL(15,2)) ELSE 0 END) as total_manual,
  SUM(CAST(valor AS DECIMAL(15,2))) as total_geral,
  COUNT(*) as qtd
FROM lancamento_custo 
WHERE periodoCustoId = (SELECT id FROM periodo_custo WHERE mes = 5 AND ano = 2026 LIMIT 1);
